payload.summary: Implemented the residual ephemeral validation-worktree prerequisite after confirming the original findings/gate/triage proposal was superseded. The helper isolates exact source state, provides an executable prepare/finalize boundary, and persists only newly changed durable artifacts through a path-hardened atomic copy-back.
completed_work: literal bash/zsh prepare-failure and signal-handler coverage

decisions.title: Narrow to residual Phase 3
decisions.rationale: introduce-fitness-function-gates explicitly superseded phases 1, 2, and 4 at 0/31 tasks; phase-scoped-worktree-lifecycle requires only the selected validation worktree.

decisions.title: Record exact commit and tree
decisions.rationale: A commit alone cannot identify an include-dirty run, so both source HEAD and the materialized Git tree are durable evidence.

decisions.title: Fail closed at filesystem boundaries
decisions.rationale: Copy-back and teardown validate identifiers, resolved containment, symlink endpoints, registered worktree ownership, and atomic replacement before mutation.

decisions.title: Keep bookkeeping durable
decisions.rationale: Architecture impact crosses the explicit allowlist; session-log and handoff writes run from the source checkout after finalization.

decisions.title: Fail closed in bash and zsh adapters
decisions.rationale: Prepare output is evaluated only after success; INT and TERM finalize then explicitly exit 130 or 143.

next_steps: Validate the residual change and open a pull request without merging.
